title: core: decode_rfc2047 hand-rolls RFC 2047 encoded-word decoding
description: core/src/ipld/header_map.rs:103 — ~50 lines hand-rolling RFC 2047 =?charset?encoding?text?= decoding. RFC 2047 has edge cases (charset variants, adjacent encoded words, folded headers, whitespace between words) that the hand-rolled version misses. The rfc2047-decoder crate (MIT) handles this correctly. Fix: add rfc2047-decoder dep to stoa-core and replace decode_rfc2047 body with rfc2047_decoder::decode().
